cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: MUFASA is an offline scientific-reasoning model for African learners, researchers and technical practitioners. The model is adapted on African research literature and supervised scientific conversations, then deployed as a compact GGUF model for local CPU inference on affordable hardware.

test_prompts.prompt: A maize field receives 30 mm of rainfall in one week and loses 20 mm of water through evapotranspiration. Ignoring runoff and drainage, what is the change in soil water storage? Show the calculation.
What does NDVI tell us about vegetation? Explain it in simple terms and state what a high NDVI value usually means.
